_note: Golden comparison against the SMM pack's bar transitions (1080x1920 at 24 fps, nested comps): their frames are rendered at the master's 25 fps with motion blur off (tools/golden/comp-frames.mjs --fps 25 --no-motion-blur, contract C35), into <comp>_25fps. The master starts at the pack's first shown frame (1 at 25 fps) and holds the first full cover (10) a frame more (spec 5): golden 0.04–0.40 s is master 0–0.36 s, golden 0.44–0.80 s is master 0.44–0.80 s, and the hold frame (master 0.40 s) is golden 0.40 s. The dark bars are «Transition_gray», green and white the pack's own comps; the logo case is «Transition with Logo» against the master logo (D18) on the dark bars. 1:1 is the middle square of the 9:16. 16:9 and 4K turn the bars a quarter and the logo on green and white has no pack frame: they are approved by eye (README).
